question: What is the name of indigenously developed special aviation fuel by the Indian Oil Corporation in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AVGAS 100 LL.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **AVGAS 100 LL** is the f indigenously developed special aviation fuel by the I**ndian Oil Corporation in 2022.**
 
• AVGAS 100 LL stands for **Aviation Gasoline 100 Low Lead.**
 
• It is a special aviation fuel **meant for piston-engine aircraft and unmanned aerial vehicles.**
 
• It was produced at **IOCL's Gujarat refinery.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL)**

 
 
• It is an Indian central public sector undertaking under the ownership of the** Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India.**
 
• It is headquartered in** New Delhi, India.**
 
• Indian Oil is ranked **142nd on the Fortune Global 500 list **of the world’s biggest corporations** as of 2022.**
 
• It is the **largest government-owned oil producer** in the country, with a** net profit of $6.1 billion** for the financial year **2020-21.**
